summary: Listmonk is a self-hosted application designed for managing mailing lists and sending newsletters through a web dashboard. It provides administrative tools to handle subscriber databases, campaigns, and delivery tracking from your own infrastructure.
goodFor: It is well-suited for developers and organisations who want to run their own bulk email infrastructure without relying on third-party SaaS providers.
watchOut: You must manage your own email deliverability reputation, SMTP relay configuration, and bounce handling, which can require significant operational effort. The copyleft AGPL-3.0 licence may also impose restrictions if you modify and network the software.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, deployment typically involves Docker and requires persistent storage for data alongside a relational database such as PostgreSQL.
